full_track.tags: K-Pop Ballad. Grand piano performs rubato arpeggios and sustained chords. A baritone male vocal delivers a breathy, emotive performance with significant chest voice in the lower register and a transition to a powerful, belted head voice in the climax. A lush string section enters with legato violins and cellos providing harmonic swells. The arrangement features a high-fidelity studio reverb on the vocals and strings. Key of E Major. Tempo is approximately 68 BPM.
